label: Cur Freq
notes: Row 0 is the Cur Freq row. FM frequency is MHz, for example 99.50. AM and SSB frequencies are KHz.
Use index 1 for memory channel 1. Keep names short for radio display compatibility.
Blank cells are ignored and keep the current radio value. Use <blank> to intentionally clear a field.
ssbBandwidth and ssbBeatFreqOffset are raw radio values; leave them blank or unchanged unless you know the value.
